company.eyebrow: Welcome to Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited (GACL): Elevating Industrial and Economic Growth in India and Enriching “Atmanirbhar Bharat”
paragraphs: GACL, a leader in the Chlor-Alkali sector, was established in 1973 in Vadodara, the cultural city of Gujarat. GACL has emerged as a shining beacon of self-reliance and an indispensable contributor to the industrial and economic growth of Gujarat and India as a whole. Our journey, nurtured under the auspices of the Government of Gujarat, has been marked by an unwavering dedication to cutting-edge technology, pioneering research and development, and strategic diversification.

products.title: Our Products
products.subtitle: Enabling Impact Across Every Facet of Life
products.text: As one of the foremost Chlor-Alkali manufacturers, our path mirrors India's remarkable progress. From our origins in caustic soda production, we have expanded to provide over 35 top-tier products. Our commitment to operational excellence aligns with global standards, ensuring our products touch and improve every aspect of life, every day.

green.title: Sustainability Goals
green.subtitle: Shaping a Brighter Future for Generations to Come
green.text: GACL stands out in the chemical manufacturing industry, driven by a diverse and dynamic product portfolio. What truly sets us apart is our unwavering commitment to sustainability and eco-friendliness. We take great pride in pioneering eco-friendly technologies, upholding rigorous safety and quality standards, and maintaining our social responsibility. At GACL, we consistently lead the way, making a profound and enduring impact on society to build a better world for future generations.

cards.title: Environment
cards.text: Our commitment to sustainability is deeply ingrained in our DNA. Our steadfast dedication to environmental responsibility propels our all-inclusive progress.

cards.title: Safety & Health
cards.text: Safety and Health are of utmost significance to us. It encompasses a multitude of facets right from the management to employees, contract workers, the workplace, the environment, and the community at large.

cards.title: CSR
cards.text: At GACL, we recognize the profound influence that businesses can exert on society. Consequently, social responsibility is not merely a duty; it is ingrained in our core values.

items.name: Shri Rashesh Gogri
items.role: Managing Director & Joint Chairman Aarti Industries Limited
items.quote: "For over 25 years, GACL has been a vital strategic supplier, fostering a mutually beneficial partnership. Our procurement of chlorine, caustic soda, hydrogen, and aluminum chloride has proven fruitful. Anticipating forthcoming hydrogen supplies from Dahej, we've secured land in Atali, signalling a commitment to future collaborations with GACL in our ongoing growth journey."

items.name: Shri R K Shetty
items.quote: Heranba Industries Limited is proud to be associated with Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited (GACL) as a prime supplier of its key raw material like Caustic lye and flakes, Benzaldehyde, Caustic potash and Aluminum chloride with timely service and good quality. We wish GACL the very best for their future endeavors and continue to play a vital role in our journey of our growth.

items.name: Smt. Disha Bajaj
items.quote: We take this opportunity to acknowledge the support of GACL as our business partner. Our association with GACL has been very progressive and the one, which is a win-win for both the partners. The transparent, committed, and disciplined management not only makes business dealings smooth but also helps explore new opportunities to develop and strengthen business. We value GACLs association and endeavour to nurture this partnership for mutual betterment.

items.name: Shri Ravindra Kelkar
items.quote: GACL has special recognition in growth journey of Thermax Chemicals Business. Highly dependable Supply Chain partner towards consistent in quality and delivery. The journey began few years ago has transformed into collaboration for Safety & Sustainability initiatives. Wish all the Success to GACL in future endeavours !

items.name: Shri Prakash Raman
items.role: Managing Director Silox India Private Limited
items.quote: Silox India appreciates the 40 years of association with GACL, we truly admire the agility of GACL to meet consistently our evolving needs and in ensuring the best possible outcomes is truly remarkable, we believe the relationship will continue to prosper in coming years.
